svg.title: Target-motion density response
svg.desc: New exploratory display of immutable primary counts, seven seed trajectories and density-wise E2 minus H contrasts. No new tests or density-specific confidence intervals.

g.text: Thin lines / open dots: seven seeds. Thick lines: means. Left axis begins at 70%.
No density-specific confidence intervals or confirmatory density claims are introduced.
